description: This file defines a React component called CopyButton, which provides a button that copies a specified text value to the clipboard and shows tooltip feedback. It handles state management for copied state, incorporates UI elements like icons and tooltips, and exposes customizable props for integration.

classes.name: CopyButton
classes.description: A React component that renders a button with copy-to-clipboard functionality, including tooltip indicators and success feedback.

methods.name: handleClick
methods.description: Asynchronous function triggered on button click to copy text to clipboard, update state for copied feedback, and handle timeouts.
